explanation: Players who know the tactics can always force at least a draw. Connect Four, solved in 1988, is a win for the first player with perfect play.

claims.text: With perfect play by both players, noughts and crosses always ends in a draw.
Against perfect play, neither player can force a win in noughts and crosses.
In noughts and crosses either player can always avoid defeat with correct play.
Connect Four was solved in 1988, showing that the first player can force a win with perfect play.
